# Security

Please do not report a security problem in a public issue.

Report it privately with GitHub's "Report a vulnerability" button on this repository's Security tab, or by email to rohin@hooknotdigital.com. Say which Completion Doctor and Moodle versions you use and how to reproduce the problem. Leave out real people's names and data.

Fixes go into a new release, and the report's author is credited in CHANGES.md unless they ask not to be.
